invitation.description: The Out-of-Band invitation, in the envelope that didcommVersion selects. Absent when the request names a `connectionId`, because the agent sends the offer on that connection.

shortUrl.description: A URL under PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL that resolves to the same invitation, for a QR code. Absent when the request names a `connectionId`.

404.description: No credential definition with the given id, or no connection with the given id
